probe_source:
import csv,hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
site=Path('/home/popac/alekpopovic.github.io');book=site/'books/inside-orch'
def load(rel):return json.loads((book/rel).read_text())
def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
rows=list(csv.DictReader((book/'state/execution-tracker.csv').open()))
assert [r['id'] for r in rows]==[f'{n:03d}' for n in range(100)]
evidence=[]
for row in rows:
 assert row['status']=='done',row['id']
 names=row['evidence'].split(';');assert all(names)
 for name in names:
  p=(book/name).resolve();assert p.is_relative_to(book) and p.is_file(),(row['id'],name)
  evidence.append({'prompt':row['id'],'path':name,'sha256':sha(p)})
lock=load('evidence/source-lock.json')
for entry in lock['files']:assert sha(book/'evidence/orch'/entry['path'])==entry['sha256'],entry['path']
gate=load('validation/release-gate.json')
assert sha(book/'validation/release-gate.json')=='d4651b1e5f5d8daac5ebaa7352b950b3cb04faf14402886576e221fea2fa4278'
assert sha(book/'validation/RELEASE_GATE.md')=='0968a32056684dd5a9838c37fa708cdbd62f1416fd638b1ab3c69f909e433f95'
assert gate['status']=='passed_local_edition_gate' and not gate['blockers']
for r in gate['evidence']:assert sha(book/r['path'])==r['sha256'],r['path']
review=load('validation/reviews/final-findings.json');assert review['status']=='passed' and not review['remaining_blockers']
for lens in review['lenses']:
 assert sha(book/lens['report'])==lens['sha256']
 assert sha(book/lens['narrative_report'])==lens['narrative_sha256']
for name,digest in load('validation/publication/manuscript-measurement.json')['inputs'].items():assert sha(book/name)==digest,name
for ext,digest in gate['artifacts'].items():
 for base in [book/'dist',site/'assets/books/inside-orch/downloads',site/'_site/assets/books/inside-orch/downloads',book/'dist/online/downloads']:
  assert sha(base/f'inside-orch.{ext}')==digest
archive=load('validation/publication/final-release-independent-verification.json')
assert archive['status']=='passed' and archive['release_zip_sha256']==sha(book/'dist/inside-orch-release.zip')
assert archive['edition_manifest_sha256']==sha(book/'publication/edition-manifest.json')
inventory=load('publication/site-adapter/final-source-inventory.json')
for r in inventory['files']:assert sha(site/r['path'])==r['sha256'],r['path']
for name in ['final-pack-validation-command','final-strict-manuscript-command','098-polished-final-five-checksums-command','099-final-local-git-inventory-command','final-native-url-preview-http-command']:
 d=load('validation/publication/'+name+'.json');assert d['status']=='passed' and d['exit_code']==0,name
http=load('validation/publication/final-local-preview-http.json');assert http['status']=='passed'
for ext,digest in gate['artifacts'].items():assert any(r.get('sha256')==digest for r in http['checks'])
required=['publication/HANDOFF.md','publication/RELEASE_NOTES.md','publication/PUBLISH_CHECKLIST.md','publication/site-adapter/pr-description.md','dist/inside-orch-release.zip','dist/inside-orch-offline.zip','dist/inside-orch-sources.zip','dist/inside-orch.pdf','dist/inside-orch.epub']
assert all((book/p).is_file() for p in required)
git=lambda *args:subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=site,text=True).strip()
assert git('branch','--show-current')=='book/inside-orch-000'
for ref in ['HEAD','main','origin/main']:assert git('rev-parse',ref)=='80801c8d3d97a4d8ff78e0fe69f3f902beda00c0'
assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only')
assert not git('diff','--check')
checksums=subprocess.run(['sha256sum','-c','SHA256SUMS.txt'],cwd=book/'dist',capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
result={'status':'passed_complete_local_handoff','checked_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'prompts_done':100,'prompts_pending':0,'source_sha':lock['baseline_sha'],'immutable_source_files_verified':len(lock['files']),
 'frozen_gate_records_unchanged':len(gate['evidence']),'review_lenses_verified':3,
 'tracker_sha256':sha(book/'state/execution-tracker.csv'),'tracker_evidence_files':evidence,
 'stable_git_inventory_files_verified':len(inventory['files']),'manuscript_measurement_words':gate['meaningful_words'],
 'pdf_pages':gate['pdf_pages'],'native_reading_sections':gate['reading_sections'],'executed_mandatory_labs':gate['mandatory_labs'],
 'release_zip_sha256':archive['release_zip_sha256'],'final_checksum_stdout':checksums.stdout,
 'actual_local_http_preview':http,'branch':git('branch','--show-current'),
 'head_main_origin_main_unchanged':True,'staged_files':[],
 'publication_action':'Local branch, canonical source, reviewable patch, final archives and optional command checklist only. No commit, push, PR, merge or live deployment.',
 'accepted_minor_erratum':'FINAL-OPS-001: disposable PostgreSQL lab names must end _test; safe upstream refusal for prefix-only names, actual runs correctly suffixed.',
 'historical_evidence_limits':'Original PostgreSQL fixture failures, six external baseline skips, split UI execution and missing exact prior lab range-report bytes remain explicitly disclosed. Actual final source/format/raster/archive bindings pass.',
 'scope':'Nonmutating final closure audit of existing actual evidence; not a new execution of all labs/browser/performance tests or production certification.',
 'probe_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
(book/'validation/publication/final-completion-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['tracker_evidence_files','probe_source','actual_local_http_preview']},indent=2))
